messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — Q3 roadmap finalization. we have 3 competing asks: reduce p99 tail for hosted, enable quantized kernels for v2 models, and a KV cache rollout for multi-tenant spikes. need to pick priorities + launch criteria.

TJ (runtime): +1. can we define hard SLOs for each? makes tradeoffs concrete.

Maya (PM): thinking: hosted p95 < 60ms, p99 < 250ms for short-seq gen; quantized v2 should not degrade quality > 1% measured on eval set; KV cache should reduce token cost by 20% for conversational flows. thoughts?

Serena (SRE): those SLOs sound reasonable but p99 250ms depends on region and burst model. we need throttling policy and a fallback plan to a cheaper model.

Eli (ML infra): quantized kernels: we can target INT8 path for the common MLP blocks first. risk: weight layout changes will break some fused kernels. estimate 3 sprints to prototype.

Andy (benchmarks): data point: on our internal A100 cluster, INT8 path gives ~1.9x throughput on short sequences, but for long-context (>4k) memory pressure spikes.

Katie (product ops): customers asking for predictable latency during launch day. they care more about p99 than p95. if we can promise a fallback and clear billing, they'll sign.

TJ (runtime): proposal: Phase 1 (sprint A) — SLO definitions + load-shed policy + small kernel opt for attention path; Phase 2 (sprint B) — INT8 kernels + quant smoke tests; Phase 3 (sprint C) — prefix KV cache canary + routing rule.

Maya (PM): good. let's agree on launch criteria per phase so we can gate rollouts.

Serena (SRE): launch criteria idea:
```
- Phase 1: can run 10k rps with p95<60ms, p99<300ms under sustained load in staging
- Phase 2: quantized path accuracy delta <1.2% on benchmark set + perf gain >1.5x
- Phase 3: KV cache reduces token usage >=18% on customer test traffic and no regression in tail latency
```

Eli (ML infra): also add a canary abort condition: if error rate >0.5% or p99 regresses >20% vs baseline, auto-rollback.

Andy (benchmarks): I'll build a small harness to replay three customer traces (chatty, embeddings-heavy, long-context). will share results by Wed.

TJ (runtime): for routing: default route -> quantized variant only if model variant supported and latency estimate < target. fallback -> non-quantized. need runtime flags and metric tags.

Maya (PM): @TJ @Eli estimate of engineering effort? we need to slot resources in the roadmap sizing doc.

TJ (runtime): rough: Phase 1: 2 engineers x 2 weeks; Phase 2: 3 engineers x 4 weeks (kernel + QA); Phase 3: 2 eng + SRE support x 3 weeks.

Eli (ML infra): depends on kernel vendor integration. if we can reuse vendor-fused kernels it's faster, otherwise add 2 weeks.

Katie (product ops): customers to notify: ACME, NovaHealth, and VectorLabs — they'll want canary opt-in. I'll prepare comms once we lock phasing.

Serena (SRE): operational checklist request: playbook for exploding KV cache memory usage, circuit breaker configs, and runbook for canary rollback.

TJ (runtime): noted. I'll draft a runbook + safe defaults.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy (eng-runtime/canary) created by @TJ for 1918769000

Maya (PM): thanks all — action items: Andy run harness (Wed), TJ + Eli estimate final (EOD Fri), Serena draft runbook (Mon), Katie comms draft (Mon). we'll reconvene Friday to set final OKR wording. :thumbsup:
